主要内容: On February 17, 2012, the Compensation Committee of SanDisk Corporation approved bonuses for fiscal year 2011 for its named executive officers. Sanjay Mehrotra, President and Chief Executive Officer, received a $1,500,000 bonus. Judy Bruner, Executive Vice President, Administration and Chief Financial Officer, received $735,400. James Brelsford, Chief Legal Officer and Senior Vice President of IP Licensing, received $360,000. Sumit Sadana, Senior Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer, received $415,300. The Committee also approved base salaries effective February 27, 2012: Mehrotra received $900,000, Bruner $567,000, Brelsford $409,500, and Sadana $425,000. Target bonus percentages for 2012 were set at 150% for Mehrotra, 100% for Bruner, and 75% for Brelsford and Sadana.
